bootstrap.undefined: Omitted from percentiles and counted per interval; all undefined yields null bounds and width.
bootstrap.unit: task, both replicates and arms together; random.Random(seed).choices(sorted_tasks, k=task_count)

definitions.iterations: All check/test runs in the retained attempt, including runs after green; rerun attempts are recorded separately.
definitions.session_confinement_breach_files: Count of sessions/*/confinement-breach.json files, including sessions absent from slot records; separate from per-arm audit-event counts, without adding duplicates.
definitions.structure_comment_only_trials: Trials whose recorded structure check passes but harness.structure fails after masking comments, retaining string literals.
definitions.thresholds: Verdicts (met and all_thresholds_met) are null, meaning not applicable, unless the sample has 30 tasks with both replicates and both arms.
definitions.tokens: All four cumulative totals from each session's last type=result event in writer.jsonl; no audit-token fallback.
definitions.turns: Distinct assistant message IDs, coordinator.audit turns; not CLI result.num_turns.
definitions.unnamed_lint_warnings: Count of short-format warning lines without a diagnostic code, per run or grade. Short-format warnings omit lint names and notes; tide-admit forces --error-format=short.
